text:
maya_csm: Kickoff for LarkPilot pilot. Customer leads: Priya (product) + Omar (platform). Aim: replace rules-based support routing with Redwood embeddings + chat. Target window: 30 days.

aditya_se: Quick infra Q — where will logs live? If they want VPC allowlist we need that early.

maya_csm: Priya says logs to GCP stackdriver, VPC allowlist may be needed for Dedicated later. For pilot we propose hosted API.

sara_enablement: I recommend two workshops: intro/runbook + evaluation & alerting. Customer attendees: product, infra, 1 support SME.

tess_successops: Renewal risk: pilot budget limited. Define escalation triggers: <60% of planned test traffic by D12 or eval pass <75%. Weekly traction email to their exec sponsor.

aditya_se: Tech checklist: API key exchange, sample dataset (anonymized), golden answers, staging traffic replay (5k), p95 target <400ms.

maya_csm: Draft timeline: D0 kickoff; D0-6 env prep & data; D7-13 integration + smoke tests; D14-20 enablement + evals; D21-30 polish & go/no-go.

sara_enablement: I'll draft runbook + pre-read and share tomorrow.

aditya_se: I'll create test harness + curl examples tonight.

onboard-bot: Meeting scheduled: "LarkPilot - Redwood Pilot Kickoff" 2024-05-02 10:00 PDT, invites sent.

maya_csm: Success criteria (confirm): integration completed; >=75% correctness on evals; p95 latency <400ms; team can run daily evals and see regressions.

tess_successops: Add D30 decision checkpoint (go/no-go + recommended commercial path).

maya_csm: Owners: integration=aditya_se; enablement=sara_enablement; metrics=tess_successops; CSM=maya_csm.

sara_enablement: Action items recap: runbook + pre-read (Sara, by Tue); test harness (Aditya, EOD); dashboard template (Tess, Wed); finalize agenda (Maya, EOD).

aditya_se: ack.

sara_enablement: ack.

tess_successops: ack, adding risk flags to dashboard.

maya_csm: Thanks team — I'll post notes after kickoff. :tada:
